decisions.reason: The USB-powered 3.3V rail and its source-selection behavior do not depend on the GPIO assigned to 5V_EN.
Changing the GPIO that controls 5V_EN does not change the AXP2101 power-management role, required rails, or battery power path.
The DCDC1 3.3V output voltage, current rating, and normal-operation role remain unchanged.
Assigning SPI MOSI to GPIO26 conflicts with the candidate's existing GPIO26 touch-wake assignment, but the source does not specify whether or how the touch-wake function should be remapped.
The GPIO remapping does not alter the battery connector family, pin count, pin functions, or unresolved physical pin order.
Battery cutoff and thermal-protection behavior are independent of the 5V_EN, SCL0, and SPI MOSI GPIO assignments.
The source does not change the charge-status LED circuit, connector, resistor, or indication path.
The TVS ESD-protection requirement is unaffected by the GPIO remapping.
The candidate explicitly defines LED rail shutdown as GPIO3-controlled, so assigning 5V_EN to GPIO5 necessarily changes its current power-control state.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Apologies, GPIO3 came from my original ESP32 design, so that was my mistake. You can assign 5V_EN to GPIO5. I also noticed that the WROOM-1 module does not expose GPIO22, 23, 25, or 27, so I need to remap SCL0 (GPIO22→38) and SPI MOSI (GPIO23→26). I will revise the documentation and send you the complete updated GPIO table.

value_updates.led_power_control: GPIO5-controlled shutdown of the complete 5V rail when the LEDs are unnecessary

decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY that records 5V_EN on GPIO5, SCL0 on GPIO38, and SPI MOSI on GPIO26; no correction or augmentation is required.
The interboard connector carries the named 5V_EN and SCL0 signals; changing their MCU-side GPIO assignments does not alter the connector pinout or signal names.
The GPIO remapping does not change the power board's dimensions, orientation, mounting, connector placement, or mechanical clearances.
